questions.question: After Balaam blessed Israel a third time, what did angry King Balak tell him to do?

answers.text: Flee at once to his home
Try again from a fourth hilltop

questions.question: Balaam said even a house full of King Balak's silver and gold could not make him do what?

answers.text: Go beyond the command of the LORD
Leave his own people behind for good
Bless the people of Moab instead

questions.question: Balaam spoke of a star coming from Jacob and a scepter rising from Israel. What was he picturing?

answers.text: A king rising up from Israel
A temple rising up in Israel
A harvest rising up in Israel

questions.question: After Balaam blessed Israel three times, King Balak said the LORD had kept Balaam from his reward. True or false?
